user.title: HAP Bridge
user.description: Creates a HomeKit bridge. Integrations that ship a hap_bridge.py describe their own devices; everything else uses a standard mapping.

abort.already_configured: A bridge already uses this port.

data.include_integrations: Only expose devices from these integrations (empty = all)
data.include_domains: Only expose these entity domains (empty = all)

profile_error.title: {integration}'s HomeKit profile has problems

start_failed.title: HAP Bridge {name} failed to start

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: Shows what HomeKit would get for a device or entity: accessories, services, current values, which step built them, validation problems, and what's left out and why. Nothing is paired or changed.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Or a single entity to preview.

config_entry_id.name: Bridge
config_entry_id.description: Which bridge's options to use (default: the first).

no_bridge.message: No HAP Bridge is set up (or that bridge isn't loaded).
